scripts.dev: bun run build.ts && concurrently "bun run build.ts --watch" "bun --hot server.ts"
scripts.build:prod: bun build src/app.ts --outdir public/src --format esm --sourcemap --target browser && mv public/src/app.js public/src/app-bundle.js && mv public/src/app.js.map public/src/app-bundle.js.map
